overview.title: Two insurance platform models, and the service center behind both.
overview.text: No two credit unions are the same, so CUFG works one on one with each partner credit union to craft a program with its members in mind.

services.title: Agency Model
services.summary: For credit unions forming a CUSO.
services.text: For credit unions that prefer to form a CUSO, hire an insurance agent, become licensed, and provide the facilities and training to implement the service.
services.lead: The Agency Model works well for an organization that has a strong cross-selling culture and is ready to take the next big step in offering more services to its members.

services.title: Life Insurance
services.text: Quote and apply for life insurance from several highly rated companies, with plans for every budget and life stage.
services.lead: The Quote and Apply tool lets you shop and compare the rates of several highly rated companies at your leisure, without pressure from salespeople. Once you have selected the plan that is right for you, complete and sign the application.

covers.title: Term life
covers.text: Protects you and your family for flexible periods of time from one to twenty years, with flexible premium payment options according to the time frames you choose.

covers.title: Whole life
covers.text: Lasts your entire lifetime as long as the premiums are paid, with set premium periods, and can build cash value.

covers.title: Universal life
covers.text: Lasts your lifetime, with premiums that can have flexible time periods and amounts, and cash value that can change but will not fall below a certain rate.

covers.title: Policy check-ups
covers.text: Our seasoned staff recognizes when it is time to get a check-up on your life insurance. When life changes, so do insurance policies, from marriage or divorce to paying for a child or grandchild's education.

questions.a: Plans are available with or without a medical exam.

questions.q: Can I speak to someone instead of applying online?
questions.a: Yes. If you prefer, contact a licensed professional at any time.

about.title: About CU Financial Group
text: CU Financial Group, LLC was founded in 2004 with the vision of offering premium insurance products to members at competitive rates. CUFG works hard to establish productive relationships with 'A Rated' insurance carriers who, like credit unions, are dedicated to member service.
With the benefit of combined credit union portfolios, we are able to negotiate the most competitive of rates for the members of credit unions in the CUFG Network.

As a credit union service organization, we are knowledgeable in credit union operations, service expectations, and financial strategies. We work with each credit union in our network to tailor their insurance program to fit their individual member needs.

Every credit union is unique. That is why CUFG works one on one with our partner credit unions to craft an insurance program with your members in mind. Our member offerings include in-person, phone, and web services.
about.imageAlt: Map marking CU Financial Group network locations in Denton, Fort Worth, Longview, San Antonio and Houston

values.title: Non-Interest Income
values.text: With tighter net interest margins than ever before, many credit unions are turning to non-interest income. Offering insurance products delivers more member-friendly services while improving the bottom line.

values.title: One-Stop Shop
values.text: Credit unions create insurance customers every day and then send them away to find insurance on their own. CUFG enables members to purchase their insurance without ever having to leave their credit union.

values.title: Trusted Advisor
values.text: As a credit union you provide trusted financial advice to your members. They trust you with their money and their loans. Why not offer them in-house insurance services that complement the loans you provide.

team.name: Christian Marrder
team.role: Principal and VP of Sales and Operations
team.bio: Christian Marrder joined CUFG in 2013 and is responsible for the day to day operations of our Insurance Service Center, where he has been instrumental in expanding capabilities and positioning the Center for future growth. Before joining CUFG, Christian was an agency owner and District trainer for reserve insurance agents in Salt Lake City, UT. He brings more than 16 years of insurance services experience and currently resides in Houston, TX.

faqs.q: Why insurance for credit union members?
faqs.a: As a credit union you provide trusted financial advice to your members. They trust you with their money and their loans. If you offer other value-added benefits like auto or home insurance, these same members will trust you to provide them with a good product. The only financial product credit union members are guaranteed to buy, every year, is insurance.

Credit unions offer competitive deposit and lending products. By becoming a member of the CU Financial Group network you will be able to provide your members with access to top rated auto, home, life, and health insurance.

faqs.q: How long does a program take to set up?
faqs.a: A Direct Model program can be implemented within 30 to 90 days.
